name: Go Sea Kayak Byron Bay
summary: A kayak tour company in Byron Bay owned by Kurt Tutt, with tours led by trained local surf lifesavers. Ocean tours paddle the Cape Byron Marine Park looking for dolphins, turtles and whales, and calmer river tours run on the Brunswick River at Brunswick Heads. Tours run all year.
standouts: Gold for Ecotourism at the NSW Tourism Awards in 2018 and 2019
Eco Certified and holds the 'Recognising Our Culture' certification
Owned by 3 time world title Surf Life Saving medallist Kurt Tutt, with surf lifesaver guides
Donates $1 from every customer to Sea Shepherd and the Southern Cross University Dolphin Research Centre

contact.address: On The Park, Opposite 56 Lawson Street, Byron Bay, NSW 2481

trips.title: Byron Bay Sea Kayak Tour
trips.summary: A guided sea kayak tour around Australia's most easterly point in the Cape Byron Marine Park, home to bottlenose dolphins, humpback whales and three species of sea turtle. Guides share local history, Aboriginal culture and marine biology, and finish by teaching you to surf the kayak back to shore. A kayaking lesson on the beach comes first, so no experience is needed.
highlights: Dolphins seen on most tours, whales in season
Led by trained local surf lifesavers
Finish by surfing your kayak to shore
trips.departsFrom: On the park, opposite 56 Lawson St, Byron Bay

prices.label: Price (homepage badge)
prices.note: Shown only as a "$99" price badge image beside this tour on the homepage. Not stated whether adult or per person.

bring: Comfortable light clothing (eg swimwear) that can get wet
Towel and clothes to change into afterwards
trips.requirements: Ages 5 and over. A good level of physical fitness is required. Children 5-15 must be with an adult. Combined weight limit of 190kg per two-person kayak. Not recommended after 15 weeks of pregnancy.

offer.text: Go Sea Guarantee: if you don't see a dolphin, turtle or whale, paddle again for free
offer.conditions: Applies to your first tour in Byron Bay. Book the free return by email with your booking reference. Not transferable and not refundable. The guarantee page says the free return has no expiry.

trips.checkNotes: Price is only in a badge image on the homepage; no text price on any tour page. Departure times conflict: "9:30am and 1:00pm" (homepage tour block, whale watching page) vs "9:30am and 1:30pm" (homepage slider); used 9:30am and 1:00pm. Meeting point conflict: "SHED 1 - opposite 58 Lawson St" on this page vs "opposite 56 Lawson St" on the other pages and contact page. Meet 30 mins before (tour pages) or 25 mins (homepage). Non-swimmers: this page says not recommended, other pages and the FAQ say physically fit non-swimmers are fine. Duration badge says 2 hours, inclusions say 2-2.5 hr. Whale season is June to October on the whale page and June to November in the FAQ. Two older duplicate pages exist (/the-byron-bay-sea-kayak-tour/, /the-best-byron-bay-kayak-tour/).

trips.title: Sunrise Byron Bay Sea Kayak Tour
trips.summary: The same guided sea kayak route as the Byron Bay tour, run at dawn with views of the coastline and the Byron Bay lighthouse. It only runs when the morning forecast is very good and the Cape Byron Marine Park approves it. Dolphins, whales and turtles may be seen.
highlights: Runs only on very good morning forecasts
Views of the coast and Byron Bay lighthouse
Led by trained local surf lifesavers
trips.departsFrom: On the park, opposite 56 Lawson St, Byron Bay
bring: Comfortable light clothing (eg swimwear) that can get wet
Towel and clothes to change into afterwards
trips.requirements: Ages 5 and over. A good level of physical fitness is required.
trips.checkNotes: No price on the site. Scheduled only on good forecasts; the homepage also says sunrise tours are available during school holidays and by appointment. No fixed time.

trips.title: Brunswick River Nature Tour
trips.summary: A gentle 2 hour guided paddle on the Brunswick River at Brunswick Heads, about 10 minutes north of Byron Bay. Tours run at high tide when the water is clearest, past sand dunes and river banks with birdlife and marine life, with a stop for a swim. Children from 3 can join, and it is the tour suggested for non-swimmers.
highlights: Runs at high tide for the clearest water
Swim stop on the river bank
trips.departsFrom: Brunswick Heads Scout Hall (riverside), 38-40 South Beach Road, Brunswick Heads

prices.label: Price (homepage badge)
prices.note: Shown only as a "$79" price badge image beside this tour on the homepage. Not stated whether adult or per person.

bring: Comfortable light clothing (eg swimwear) that can get wet
Towel and clothes to change into afterwards
trips.requirements: Ages 3 and over. Children must be with an adult. Physically fit non-swimmers are welcome.
trips.checkNotes: Price only in a homepage badge image. Departure time changes daily with the high tide. Meet 10 mins before (homepage).

trips.title: Sunset Brunswick River Kayak Tour
trips.summary: An easy evening paddle on the Brunswick River, through mangrove channels as the sun sets behind the hinterland. Guides explain how mangroves filter the river, and rays, herons, eagles and kingfishers are often seen. It suits beginners and families with kids from 3.
highlights: Easy, suitable for kids 3 and over
Runs year round, times follow sunset
trips.departsFrom: Brunswick Heads Scout Hall, South Beach Rd, Brunswick Heads

prices.label: Per person
prices.note: $75.00pp. Family and locals discounts available (amounts not stated).

trips.requirements: Easy, suitable for beginners and kids 3 and over.

offer.conditions: Discount amounts not stated on the site.

trips.checkNotes: The page gives a sample schedule (meet 4:30pm, finish by 6:30pm) marked "for example purposes" and "seasonal", so no departure time is recorded. The page says it meets at a "Brunswick River launch site" in the schedule and at the Scout Hall below it.

trips.title: Christmas Parties
trips.summary: A Christmas party package that starts with a London double decker bus from Byron Bay to the Brunswick River for a guided sunset kayak tour. Afterwards the group stops at the Hotel Bruns for a drink before the bus returns to Byron Bay. It suits work teams, friends and families.
highlights: London double decker bus transfers from Byron Bay
Sunset kayak on the Brunswick River
Drinks stop at the Hotel Bruns
trips.departsFrom: Byron Bay (bus transfer to the Brunswick River)
includes: Sunset kayak tour on the Brunswick River
trips.checkNotes: No price, duration or dates on the site. The page does not say whether drinks at the Hotel Bruns are included in the price. The page only says "This Christmas", with no dates.

trips.title: School Groups
trips.summary: Kayaking excursions for school groups on the Brunswick River, mixing paddling with lessons on mangroves, native wildlife and local ecology. Guides set the difficulty to the group's experience and provide all equipment. Programs are arranged by enquiry.

trips.title: Private Groups
trips.summary: Private guided kayak trips for a single group, either on the ocean at Byron Bay or on the Brunswick River. Guides give full instruction so beginners can join. Rates are by email enquiry.
highlights: Choice of Byron Bay ocean or Brunswick River
trips.checkNotes: Enquiry only. The FAQ says to email info@goseakayak.com.au for availability and rates.

trips.title: Corporate Groups
trips.summary: Team-building sea kayak trips for companies in Byron Bay, guided with full instruction so novices can take part. The day is built around teamwork on the water. Bookings are by enquiry.

offers.text: Gift vouchers for any kayak tour
offers.conditions: Can be used once and are not refundable. Bought through https://goseakayak.rezdy.com/catalog/1200/gift-vouchers (not opened). An older shop page on the site lists Dolphin or River Kayak Tours vouchers at Family $230.00, Adult $75.00 and Child $50.00.

offers.text: Discounts for groups of 10 or more
offers.conditions: Email info@goseakayak.com.au. No discounted tickets for public holidays, school holidays, long weekends or peak weekends. Amount not stated.

checkNotes: Only two image-only price badges ($99 Byron Bay, $79 Brunswick River) and one text price ($75 Sunset Brunswick) appear on the site; other prices are only in the Rezdy widget. The /shop/ voucher prices come from a WooCommerce shop last updated in 2018 that is not in the menu (the menu's Gift Vouchers goes to Rezdy), so treat them as possibly stale. Pick-ups: the Terms and FAQ say no pick-ups, but another FAQ answer says they provide snacks and drinks and free accommodation pick-up; treat pick-up as not offered. Office hours differ between the footer (8am to 6pm, 7 days) and the contact page (8am to 5pm Mon to Sat, 8am to 1pm Sun). The footer badge image reads "ECO Certified advanced ecotourism" (file name mentions Green Travel Leader) but the page text only says "Eco Certified". The homepage claims they are the only Byron Bay tour company with both Eco and Recognising Our Culture certification; not used. The /about/go-sea-guarantee/ link from the homepage returns 404; the guarantee is on /about/go-sea-free-return-tour/ and the Terms.
